title: Implement pure weekly recurrence and schedule functions with tests
acceptance_criteria: Pure functions normalize weekly entries and return immutable results for adding, updating, removing, and grouping assignments.
A deterministic recurrence function produces the requested week view from a supplied week anchor without relying on the current clock or browser globals.
Multiple assignments on one day, empty/rest days, invalid times, and missing routine references have explicit pass/fail behavior covered by tests.
Tests cover happy paths, boundaries, malformed input, and immutability with descriptive independent cases.
No recurrence function performs localStorage, notification, or React side effects.
